matcher_enabled.description: Add Match performers to Images and Galleries. Review filename and folder suggestions in batches. Nothing is assigned or created until you apply the reviewed matches. Reload after enabling.

attributes_enabled.description: Enable this module. Reload the page after changing this switch. Existing automation switches are kept separately.

attributes__measurementUnits.description: auto, cm or inches. Automatic detection is an estimate; use an explicit unit if uncertain.

attributes__inferBodyMeasurements.displayName: Estimate body shape from numeric measurements
attributes__inferBodyMeasurements.description: Adjust estimate body shape from numeric measurements. Changes affect this module only. Preview metadata changes before applying them.

attributes__shapeInferenceRules.description: Body-shape estimates from bust/waist/hips when height and weight are unavailable. Rule syntax and limitations are documented in RULE-FORMATS.md.

attributes__inferBreastNumeric.displayName: Estimate breast-size category from bust circumference
attributes__inferBreastNumeric.description: Adjust estimate breast-size category from bust circumference. Changes affect this module only. Preview metadata changes before applying them.

attributes__bustInferenceRules.description: Estimate breast-size categories from numeric bust circumference, not cup size. See RULE-FORMATS.md. Circumference alone cannot establish a bra cup.

attributes__inferBody.displayName: Estimate body type from height and weight
attributes__inferBody.description: Optional height (cm) / weight (kg) estimate. Ordered rules; first match wins. This is a user-defined classification, not a medical assessment.

attributes__bodyInferenceRules.description: Ordered rules, separated by semicolons. Each rule uses conditions followed by =Body Type. Open RULE-FORMATS.md for syntax and examples. First matching rule wins.

attributes__inferBreastSize.displayName: Estimate breast-size category from cup code
attributes__inferBreastSize.description: Optional category estimate from the cup code in Measurements. Repeated letters such as DD and DDD have editable rules below.

attributes__cupInferenceMap.description: One rule per line, separated by semicolons: source value=Tag Name. A custom list replaces the starter list. Existing tag aliases are reused.

attributes__createTags.description: Create missing tags. If disabled, only existing tags or aliases are used.

attributes__removeStale.description: Remove previously inherited tags that no longer match the enabled rules. Manual unrelated tags are retained.

attributes__manageMappedTags.displayName: Also reconcile legacy / manually assigned mapped tags
attributes__manageMappedTags.description: Also reconcile matching legacy attribute tags. This may remove manually assigned tags from the mapped vocabulary. Preview first.

images__a_maxImagesPerSlot.description: Adjust max images per slot. Changes affect this module only. Preview metadata changes before applying them.

images__a_selectionMode.description: How each slot chooses among multiple matches: first or random (Default: first)

images__a_loopSlots.description: Repeat slots for infinite scrolling behavior (Default: true)

images__a_defaultPanelState.description: expanded, collapsed, or remember last state (Default: remember; falls back to expanded if no saved state exists)

images__a_slotInfoPosition.description: Whether the tag label row is shown at the top or bottom of the slot: top or bottom (Default: top)

images__a_imageHeight.description: Sets the minimum height of slots and influences how tall slots can grow (Default: 210)

images__a_panelWidth.description: Panel width in pixels for the performer page panel (Default: 300)

images__a_autoFitSlotCrops.description: Automatically fit images to their slot aspect ratio when added to slots or loaded in the panel (Default: true)

images__a_panelBackgroundColor.description: Background color for the slot header/footer panels (Default: #808080)

images__a_panelOpacity.description: Background opacity for the slot header/footer panels from 0 to 1 (Default: 0.1)

images__a_overlayBackgroundColor.description: Background color for buttons and labels (Default: #808080)

images__a_overlayBackgroundOpacity.description: Background opacity for buttons and labels from 0 to 1 (Default: 0.3)

images__a_overlayFontColor.description: Text and icon color for buttons and labels (Default: #ffffff)

images__a_overlayFontSize.description: Font size in pixels for buttons and labels (Default: 13)

images__a_openInNewTab.description: Open the image page in a new tab when clicking a supporting image (Default: true)

images__a_cardPreviewHoverBehavior.description: How the performer card preview opens: performer card, badge, or disabled (Default: badge)

images__a_cardPreviewPanelWidth.description: Width in pixels for the hover preview panel shown on performer cards (Default: 500)

images__a_cardPreviewPanelHeight.description: Height in pixels for the hover preview panel shown on performer cards (Default: 500)

images__a_cardPreviewBackgroundColor.description: Background color for the hover preview panel shown on performer cards (Default: #000000)

images__a_cardPreviewShowEmptySlots.description: Show blank placeholders for missing performer card preview slots so slot order and gaps stay visible (Default: false)

images__a_cardPreviewSlotOrder.description: Six digits using each slot number once to control preview order, for example 123456 or 145623 (Default: 123456)
